tasks.label: Downlink: Start dev
args: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"; if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ -s ${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh ]]; then source "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh"; fi; mkdir -p ../../target; pidfile=../../target/vscode-dev.pid; if [[ -f $pidfile ]] && kill -0 -- -$(cat "$pidfile") 2>/dev/null; then echo 'Downlink dev is already running.'; exit 0; fi; setsid bash -c 'echo $$ > ../../target/vscode-dev.pid; exec cargo tauri dev --config "$DOWNLINK_DEV_CONFIG"' & child=$!; cleanup() { trap '' TERM; if [[ -f $pidfile ]]; then kill -TERM -- -$(cat "$pidfile") 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$pidfile"; fi; }; trap cleanup EXIT; trap 'exit 0' INT TERM; wait "$child"

tasks.label: Downlink: Stop dev
args: pidfile=target/vscode-dev.pid; if [[ -f $pidfile ]]; then kill -TERM -- -$(cat "$pidfile") 2>/dev/null || true; else echo 'Downlink dev is not running.'; fi

tasks.label: Downlink: Install dev dependencies
tasks.detail: Install Debian/Ubuntu native libraries, Node/pnpm and Rust if missing, Tauri CLI, and project dependencies. sudo may prompt for your password.
args:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
if [[ -s ${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh ]]; then source "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh"; fi
if ! command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'This setup task requires Debian or Ubuntu.' >&2; exit 1; fi
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y build-essential pkg-config curl ca-certificates libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libgtk-3-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev libmpv-dev libssl-dev patchelf ffmpeg python3 util-linux
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if command -v nvm >/dev/null 2>&1; then nvm install --lts; else sudo apt-get install -y nodejs npm; fi
fi
node -e 'const [major, minor] = process.versions.node.split(".").map(Number); if (!(major === 20 && minor >= 19 || major === 22 && minor >= 12 || major >= 24)) { console.error("Vite needs Node 20.19+, 22.12+, or 24+. Update Node and rerun setup."); process.exit(1); }'
if ! command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo apt-get install -y npm; fi
  npm install --global --prefix "$HOME/.local" pnpm@10
fi
if ! command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  installer=$(mktemp)
  curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs -o "$installer"
  sh "$installer" -y --default-toolchain none
  rm -f "$installer"
fi
rustup show
rustup component add clippy rustfmt
cargo install tauri-cli --version '^2' --locked
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
cargo fetch --locked
printf '\nDevelopment dependencies are ready. Run Downlink: Start dev.\n'
